error.invalid_time_range: End time must be after start time.

set_override.name: Set Override
set_override.description: Activates a temporary slot override with a specific preset for a period or duration.

override_id.name: Override ID
override_id.description: Unique ID for the override (e.g. guests or party). Optional.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: The preset to activate (e.g. comfort, boost, eco).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the override (e.g. 1 hour, 30 minutes). Starts immediately if no start time is specified.

start.name: Start Time
start.description: Start time of the override (e.g. 14:00 or ISO timestamp). Optional when duration is set.

end.name: End Time
end.description: End time of the override (e.g. 16:00 or ISO timestamp). Optional when duration is set.

remove_override.name: Remove Override
remove_override.description: Prematurely cancels an active temporary slot override.

override_id.name: Override ID
override_id.description: The ID of the override to remove (e.g. guests or party).

reset_heating_rates.name: Reset Heating Rates
reset_heating_rates.description: Deletes all learned heating rates (matrix & overall average) and resets to default values.

set_manual_heating_rate.name: Set Manual Heating Rate
set_manual_heating_rate.description: Manually sets the overall average heating rate (in K/h) for this room.

rate.name: Heating Rate (K/h)
rate.description: Expected heating rate in Kelvin/hour (°C/h). E.g. 1.2 for fast heating or 0.7 for underfloor heating.

set_matrix_heating_rate.name: Set/Add Matrix Heating Rate
set_matrix_heating_rate.description: Adds or updates an outdoor temperature heating rate bucket in the matrix.

temperature.name: Outdoor Temperature (°C)
temperature.description: The outdoor temperature for this bucket (e.g. -5, 0, 5, 12) or 'default'.

rate.name: Heating Rate (K/h)
rate.description: Heating rate in Kelvin per hour (°C/h) for this outdoor temperature.

delete_matrix_heating_rate.name: Delete Matrix Heating Rate
delete_matrix_heating_rate.description: Deletes an outdoor temperature heating rate entry from the matrix.

temperature.name: Outdoor Temperature (°C)
temperature.description: The outdoor temperature of the entry to delete (e.g. 5, -2) or 'default'.

set_matrix_cooling_rate.name: Set/Add Matrix Cooling Rate
set_matrix_cooling_rate.description: Adds or updates an outdoor temperature cooling rate bucket in the matrix.

temperature.name: Outdoor Temperature (°C)
temperature.description: The outdoor temperature for this bucket (e.g. -5, 0, 5, 12) or 'default'.

rate.name: Cooling Rate (K/h)
rate.description: Cooling rate in Kelvin per hour (°C/h) for this outdoor temperature.

delete_matrix_cooling_rate.name: Delete Matrix Cooling Rate
delete_matrix_cooling_rate.description: Deletes an outdoor temperature cooling rate entry from the matrix.

temperature.name: Outdoor Temperature (°C)
temperature.description: The outdoor temperature of the entry to delete (e.g. 5, -2) or 'default'.
